name: Creality Falcon T1
tagline: 2026 modular galvo workstation — swap diode, fiber, MOPA, or UV heads
tldr: Creality's Falcon T1 (global launch May 2026) is a Class 1 enclosed galvo platform with swappable WaveSync modules: 20W/40W diode, 20W fiber, 60W MOPA, and 5W UV. Buy the base once, add laser types as your shop grows — competes with xTool F1/F2 Ultra on flexibility rather than fixed dual-laser boxes.
mainObjective: Modular enclosed galvo for makers who want one chassis and multiple laser types

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: All modules at once — one head installed

pros: Covers metal, organics, and UV in one ecosystem
cons: Total cost rises quickly with modules
New 2026 platform — limited long-term community data
Galvo bed smaller than Falcon 2 Pro open frame
Module swap downtime between job types
beginnerNotes: Start with the diode module if wood/leather is 80% of work; add fiber when metal sales justify it. Compare fixed xTool F1 Ultra if you know you need metal + wood day one.
proTips: Price the full module roadmap before buying — T1 plus fiber and MOPA can exceed a single F2 Ultra bundle.
primaryUse: 2026 modular galvo production platform for shops that want to expand laser types without replacing the entire machine.
